intro: Moldova is one of Europe's poorest countries, and many of its people work abroad.

chapters.title: People and languages
text: Chișinău is the capital. Romanian is the official language, and Russian is widely spoken. The Gagauz, a Turkic-speaking Christian people, have their own autonomous region. Most people are Orthodox Christians.
Hundreds of thousands of Moldovans work abroad, especially in Italy, Russia and other EU countries, and many hold Romanian passports.

chapters.title: Food
text: Mămăligă (maize porridge), plăcinte (filled pastries) and sarmale (stuffed cabbage leaves) are traditional dishes.

keyTerms.meaning: An area that runs many of its own affairs.
